Brave Wilderness is your one stop connection to a wild world of adventure and amazing up close animal encounters! 

Follow along with Coyote Peterson and Mark Vins as they lead you on a variety of expeditions featuring everything from Grizzly Bears and Crocodiles to King Cobras and Murder Hornets! Every single episode offers an opportunity to learn something new about incredible species that call our planet home.
      
So SUBSCRIBE NOW and join the adventure that brings you closer to the most beloved, bizarre and misunderstood creatures on earth! 

Be Brave, Stay Wild!
 
Join the Brave Crew by becoming a member today - http://bit.ly/JOINBWM
